connector.name: Postproxy
connector.registryDescription: Publish, schedule, and manage social media posts across major platforms via the Postproxy API.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.postproxy.dev over streamable HTTP. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace dev.postproxy. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

headers.name: X-PostProxy-API-Key
headers.description: Your Postproxy API key (from the Postproxy dashboard). Optional: leave blank to authenticate via OAuth (the server supports dynamic client registration) instead.
